-- Data-quality check: products sold before their launch date
-- Write it from scratch. One row per offending product with:
--   product_id, name, launched_on, first_sold (YYYY-MM-DD), lines
SELECT product_id, name, launched_on
FROM products;
solution:
SELECT
  p.product_id,
  p.name,
  p.launched_on,
  date(MIN(o.order_date)) AS first_sold,
  COUNT(*) AS lines
FROM order_items AS oi
JOIN orders AS o ON o.order_id = oi.order_id
JOIN products AS p ON p.product_id = oi.product_id
WHERE o.order_date < p.launched_on
GROUP BY p.product_id, p.name, p.launched_on;
